commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Daniel Farke decides to make a substitution. Noah Okafor will be replaced by Jack Harrison (Leeds).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and James Justin (Leeds) comes onto the pitch so that Gabriel Gudmundsson can be given a rest.
87' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Leeds.
84' Referee John Brooks points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Leeds players.
84' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Leeds players aren’t happy.

82' 1 - 1 Wilfried Gnonto produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:1.
81' Keith Andrews prepares a substitution. Mathias Jensen is replaced by Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford).
80' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
80' It will be a substitution. Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) is ready to enter the pitch as Vitaly Janelt walks off.
78' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
75' Corner kick. Leeds will have an opportunity.
75' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but the keeper dives and denies him.
73' Daniel Farke has decided to make a change. Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) replaces Ao Tanaka.
73' Jaka Bijol comes off the pitch to be replaced by Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds).
73' Referee John Brooks points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Brentford players celebrate.
72' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Brentford players aren’t happy.
70' 1 - 0 Goal! Jordan Henderson (Brentford) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
69' The attendance is 17159.
68' 57:43 – the latest ball possession ratio.
66' Anton Stach (Leeds) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
61' Keith Andrews has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rico Henry (Brentford) replacing Aaron Hickey.
61' Substitution. Keane Lewis-Potter makes his way off the pitch and Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) comes on as his replacement.
60' Brentford are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
58' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
57' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
51' Aaron Hickey (Brentford) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. John Brooks blows his whistle for an infringement.
50' Anton Stach (Leeds) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
48' Anton Stach (Leeds) will take a corner kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Noah Okafor (Leeds) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
43' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
42' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Lucas Perri makes a comfortable save.
41' Brentford control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
38' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Brentford! VAR comes to the rescue of referee John Brooks and both teams have no complaints.
36' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Brentford as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
35' John Brooks blows the whistle, Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) is penalised for a foul. Brentford have been awarded a penalty kick!
33' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
30' 67:33 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
29' Noah Okafor (Leeds) blows a big chance from close range. World class save by the goalkeeper.

25' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Lucas Perri!
22' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) will take the free kick.
19' The Brentford players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' A pass from Michael Kayode (Brentford) is intercepted by Lucas Perri and the move breaks down.
14' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Leeds comes to nothing.
10' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
5' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
4' Poor challenge! Ao Tanaka (Leeds) is penalised for tripping and John Brooks blows his whistle.
1' The first half has started.
